description_en: Queries acceleration traffic or bandwidth usage data
description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速流量或带宽用量数据
name: DescribeVodDomainUsageData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all accelerated domain names is returned by default. Batch queries are supported. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名。若参数为空，默认返回所有加速域名合并后数据。支持批量查询，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据起始时间点。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据结束时间点，需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The data type. Valid values:
bps: bandwidth.
traf: traffic
parameters.help_zh:
数据类型。取值：
bps：带宽。
traf：流量
parameters.name: field

parameters.help_en:
The type of usage data to retrieve. Valid values:

static: static content.
dynamic: dynamic content.
all: all content
parameters.help_zh:
需要获取的用量类型。取值：

static：静态。
dynamic：动态。
all：全部
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The region code. Default value: CN (the Chinese mainland). Valid values:
CN: the Chinese mainland.
OverSeas: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
地域代号。默认为CN中国大陆。取值：
CN：中国大陆。
OverSeas：海外区域
parameters.name: area

parameters.help_en:
Forces the retrieval of data at the specified time granularity, in seconds. Valid values: 300 (5 minutes), 3600 (1 hour), and 86400 (1 day).
Interval=300: You can query data for up to the last half year. The maximum time span for a single query is 3 days.
Interval=3600 or 86400: You can query data for up to the last year.
If Interval is not specified: The maximum time span for a single query is 1 month. If the query time range is 1 to 3 days, data is returned at hourly granularity. If the query time range is 4 days or more, data is returned at daily granularity
parameters.help_zh:
强制指定获取指定时间粒度的数据，单位为秒。支持300（5分钟）、3600（1小时）和86400（1天）。
Interval=300：最长可查询最近半年的数据，单次查询的时间跨度最长为3天。
Interval=3600或86400：最长可查询最近1年的数据。
不指定Interval：单次查询跨度最长为1个月。当查询时间为1~3天时，数据按小时粒度返回；当查询时间为4天及以上时，数据按天粒度返回
parameters.name: interval

DataInterval.description_en: The time interval between records. Unit: seconds
DataInterval.description_zh: 每条记录的时间间隔。单位：秒

EndTime.description_en: The end time. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)

StartTime.description_en: The start time. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)

Type.description_en:
The data type. Valid values:
bps: bandwidth.
traf: traffic
Type.description_zh:
数据类型。取值：
bps：带宽。
traf：流量
